O que você lê, ouve ou ama vai para o ac: What you read, hear or love goes into the accusative, the form for the thing the verb acts on (in English: «I read the book», where «the book» is the object). Only feminine words in -а and -я change: -а → -у, -я → -ю. Masculine and neuter nouns that are not people or animals do not change. Masculine people and animals use the same form as after «нет»: Я люблю брата. The verbs «любить», «смотреть» and «говорить» have another pattern: люблю, любишь, любит, любим, любите, любят.
